World map, minimap, markers and discovery

A map presents authored geography and server-approved discovery. Minimap position is local presentation of approved movement; hidden quest/resource details are not indiscriminately replicated to every client.

Scope and player interaction

A map presents authored geography and server-approved discovery. Minimap position is local presentation of approved movement; hidden quest/resource details are not indiscriminately replicated to every client.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase17committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Unexplored → Discovered → Tracked → MarkerSelected → TravelEligible

WBP_Map observes results from URPGDiscoveryComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Map_Rillmere. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
RegionId/LandmarkId/MarkerId: stable IDs and zone-local transforms
MapProjection: world X/Y bounds to normalized map coordinates; Z layers explicit for interiors
DiscoveredRegionIds and UnlockedHubIds: durable character facts
MarkerVisibilityPolicy: Public|Discovered|QuestOwner|Party|Hidden
MapTexture/VectorLayout: separate authored art, not supplied by sprite archive
SelectedWaypoint: local preference; navigation is advisory, not teleport authority

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGDiscoveryComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_MapLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RecordDiscovery(RegionId, VerifiedPositionEvent) -> Discovered|AlreadyKnown
SetTrackedQuest(QuestId) -> LocalTrackingUpdated; owner preference
ResolveMapMarkers(CharacterContext) -> VisibleMarkerViews
RequestFastTravelFromMarker(HubId) -> TravelRequest; delegates to validated travel service

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Server verifies the capsule entered a registered discovery volume on a valid surface and emits a stable discovery event.
  2. Backend adds the region/landmark unlock once, returns revision and any deliberately authored reward entitlement.
  3. UI overlays discovered regions, quest-owner markers, party markers and current approved location using the zone map transform.
  4. Interior/bridge layers use explicit floor/layer IDs; do not pretend a flat sprite map automatically describes every 3D height.
  5. Selecting a marker shows route/zone destination and services; only unlocked safe hubs expose fast-travel requests.
  6. On zone handoff switch map catalog after destination readiness; clear old actor markers and retain durable discoveries.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_Map_Rillmere with world bounds, layers and marker catalog. Add BP_DiscoveryVolume at OldSluice and west road regions.
  2. Build WBP_Map and WBP_Minimap with icons plus text labels/legend, zoom/pan and controller focus; minimap rotation remains fixed to the camera/world convention.
  3. Reopen quest/NPC/gate definitions to assign marker IDs and visibility policy, not hardcoded widget coordinates.
  4. Author a simple rights-cleared graybox map diagram until proper map art is produced. Register its source/provenance separately.
  5. Test every zone entrance against the map transform and validate reciprocal gate destinations.

Reopen Phase17 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Landmark_OldSluice / Region_WestRoad. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Client requests discovery without being in volume -> reject; no unlock.
Duplicate entry/reconnect -> one discovery record/reward.
Quest marker from old zone arrives late -> ignored by zone generation.
Minimap maps bridge to wrong layer -> content validation/QA failure, not navigation teleport.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed landmark spacing 2–4 minutes walking and map reveal by authored regions rather than per-pixel fog. These are content pacing targets, not measured world scale.

Log discovery event IDs and map transform errors. Markers have labels/shapes and adjustable scale; important paths are not color-only.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
